subject: Post-demo econ recap + credit gate for pilot extension
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@northshore.ai>
Cc: Alan Park <alan.park@northshore.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo econ recap + credit gate for pilot extension

Emma / Alan — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep the pilot healthy and measurable.

Summary of what we discussed
- Pilot scope: 3-week extension to test real traffic to the recommender endpoint + A/B delta on prompt templates.
- Expected token profile during extension: ~20M tokens/week (burst ~4M tokens/day) driven by 6k daily sessions; average prompt length ~1.2k tokens.
- Pilot totals (est): ~60M tokens over 3 weeks.

Cost & unit economics (what you asked for)
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: target $/1M tokens around $300.
- At 60M tokens that maps to est. pilot spend of ~$18k if we hit $300/1M.
- We discussed a budget window of $12k–$25k for the extension — sounds aligned with your procurement guardrails.

Credit ask and proposal
- To remove friction and give you headroom to validate integrations, Redwood can provide an initial credit tranche.
- Proposal: $15k immediate credit to extend the pilot + conditional additional $10k credit if the pilot meets the activation trigger (>=5k daily active sessions for 7 consecutive days).
- Conditions: credits to be applied to usage for the model variant used in the demo (rwd-v2-highperf); credits expire 45 days after issue.

Operational asks / next steps (owner in parentheses)
1) Please confirm you want the 3-week extension and accept the credit conditions (Emma/Alan).
2) If yes, I’ll route the trial addendum to procurement (Sean) — this is a short DocuSign.
3) Marissa / Ben: can you bless the $15k immediate credit? If yes I’ll issue and share credit id with Alan for tracking.
4) Alan: please confirm the procurement contact and if a PO is required before we issue the second tranche.

Attachments: northshore_cost_model.xlsx (simple token-driven cost projection)

Thanks — I’ll check back early next week.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Emma Liu <emma@northshore.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Park <alan.park@northshore.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo econ recap + credit gate for pilot extension

Thanks, Sean — this is helpful. Couple clarifying items from our side:
- The 20M tokens/week estimate is the realistic mid-case for our traffic pattern; peak days could go up to ~6.5M tokens. Can you confirm the burst handling and whether the rate limits you applied in the demo will stay in place?
- Procurement: I’m the internal PM but our procurement lead is Alan (cc’d). We typically need a short addendum + PO for credits above $10k.

On the $/1M tokens target: $300 is within the ballpark we were expecting but we need to see an explicit cost cap on the high-velocity path — i.e., how does Redwood protect us from accidental spikes during the pilot?

Yes to the 3-week extension in principle. If Redwood can provide a $15k initial credit and keep a hard cap or throttling control we can sign the addendum quickly. Please note: we rarely commit to conditional additional credits without a PO up front — Alan, can you confirm?

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Product, Northshore AI
emma@northshore.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo econ recap + credit gate for pilot extension

Sean / Ben — forwarding Emma’s note. Quick decision: I authorize an immediate $15k trial credit for Northshore on the conditions Sean listed. A couple of operational constraints:
- Credit applied only to rwd-v2-highperf endpoint and cannot be used for other accounts or model classes.
- Set a usage guardrail: once usage reaches 120% of forecasted weekly tokens, notify AE + throttle to 1.5x baseline until we have explicit signoff.
- Billing team should require a PO for the second tranche; do not auto-release.

Sean: Ben will work with BillingOps to create the credit code and visibility. Ben, please set expiration 45 days and tag with deal_id HS-2467.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior AE Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@northshore.ai>, Alan Park <alan.park@northshore.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo econ recap + credit gate for pilot extension

Emma / Alan — great, thanks for the quick reply and context. Confirming the path:
- Redwood will issue a $15k credit today scoped to the demo endpoint (rwd-v2-highperf). Credit id and expiration sent in a follow-up from BillingOps.
- Throttling / spike protection: we’ll set an automatic alert at 100% of forecast and soft-throttle at 120% (as Marissa suggested) — we’ll also expose the throttle toggle to your engineering lead so you can lift it if needed.
- Second tranche ($10k) requires a PO from Northshore and the activation trigger (>=5k DAU for 7 days).

Next steps (short list):
1) I’ll send the DocuSign addendum now — please sign (Emma). Link: https://docusign.com/link/trial-addendum-HS-2467
2) Ben will issue the credit and share credit code + HubSpot tag.
3) Alan — confirm if a PO is required for the second tranche. If yes, please send PO contact and timing.

Attached is an updated cost model with the credit applied (northshore_cost_model.xlsx) and a PDF copy of the short addendum (redwood_trial_addendum.pdf).

If all good I’ll close this loop and push the addendum for signature.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Sean
